From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP Kickoff: Mobilization Plan & Owner Commitments — Nimbus Financial

Hi Alex / Jill —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Nimbus Financial that lays out milestone windows, proposed owners, and required artifacts for each phase (discovery -> integration -> validation -> go-live). The intent is to get alignment on owner names, acceptance criteria, and a realistic go-live window so our teams can commit resources.

Quick highlights:
- Suggested kickoff workshop: Aug 10 (60–90m) — cover scope, security checklist, and roles.
- MVP scope: API ingestion + conversational routing only (Embeddings to follow in Q2).
- Critical path owner requests: Nimbus to confirm SSO owner and data-retention approver for audit logs.

Please review the MAP-v1.docx and the MVP-deliverables.csv attached. If you can confirm owners for the two items above by EOD Aug 6, we can lock milestone dates and reserve a Dedicated capacity slot for Aug 24–Sep 7 (if needed).

Next steps I propose:
1) Nimbus confirms owner names for SSO + data retention (by 2026-08-06)
2) Workshop scheduled (Marissa to send calendar invite once Alex/Jill confirm)
3) Redwood to provide initial staging provision details after the workshop (target 3 business days)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP-v1.docx (draft), MVP-deliverables.csv

Thanks Marissa — good outline. A few technical notes for the team and for the workshop: 

- Redwood technical lead for integration will be Karthik (cc'd). He'll present the ingestion pattern and tokenization guidance in the kickoff.
- For Dedicated capacity: we can pre-reserve a node for the Aug 24 window but need final estimate of peak concurrent requests. If Nimbus expects >120 concurrent sessions, flag that and we'll size accordingly.
- I'll attach a short staging checklist (SLA-exceptions.xlsx) after this thread — includes IP allowlist and test dataset guidance.

Alex — can you confirm if the team prefers TLS mTLS termination at the load-balancer or with our sidecar? That will influence the staging network diagram we share.

-Ben

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Mobilization Plan & Owner Commitments — Nimbus Financial

Alex / Jill — following up with suggested owner commitments and milestone dates for your review. I pulled dates conservative to allow for procurement and security review. If you want us to compress any phase we can, but we need sign-off on the acceptance criteria listed in the MAP.

Proposed owner matrix (short):
- Project Sponsor: Jill Harper (Nimbus)
- Product/PO: Alex Wu (Nimbus)
- SSO/ID: TBD (Nimbus) — required for staging access
- Data Retention/Compliance: TBD (Nimbus) — required for audit sign-off
- Redwood Delivery Lead: Priyom Das (Redwood)
- Redwood Integration Lead: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)

Milestone windows (target):
- Discovery & requirements: Aug 10–Aug 17
- Integration sprint 1 (API + Auth): Aug 18–Sep 3
- Validation & QA: Sep 6–Sep 14
- Preflight + Ops runbook: Sep 15–Sep 21
- Go-live target: Sep 22 (soft launch)

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- SSO provisioned and test user authentication passes for 3 role types
- Ingestion pipeline processes 10k sample events/hour without >5% error
- Latency under 350ms p50 for the primary API route in staging

Can you confirm the two Nimbus owners (SSO + Data Retention) and indicate whether procurement needs any pre-bill PO or contract redline before Aug 12? If procurement needs a DocuSign link, we'll route the final SOW there immediately.

Thanks — Priyom

—
Priyom Das
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Priyom — thanks for the clear MAP. A few notes from Nimbus side: 

- SSO owner: Jorge Mendoza will own SSO and will be on the kickoff (jorge.mendoza@nimbus.com).
- Data retention/compliance: I'll loop in Legal; interim owner is me for sign-off but Legal will confirm by Aug 9.
- Procurement note: we need the final SOW + a short statement of work summary (one pager) before we can raise the PO. Procurement (procurement@nimbus.com) is cc'd on this thread. They requested an initial timeline and the expected billing cadence (monthly).

Proposed kickoff: Aug 12 at 10:00am PT — gives us a few days to confirm Legal + procurement details. Is that acceptable for the Redwood team?

Also, regarding mTLS: we prefer termination at our LB and will share network CIDRs for the allowlist by Aug 9.

Thanks — Alex
